'''Adar 17 (April 29)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - At breakfast, [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] encounter [[Paitr Conel]], a young [[Darkfriend]]. That evening, they arrive at another small village. At the inn, The [[Queen's Man]], Rand falls ill, a reaction to channeling two days ago, so they stay in the stable.
